draft_text: The reported 142 versus 119 requests per second provide tentative evidence that Nimbrake might possibly achieve higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve.
revised_text: The reported 142 versus 119 requests per second are not directly comparable because Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16, so they do not establish that Nimbrake achieves higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve.
rationale: Numbers 142 vs 119 rps are correct (T1.r1.rps, T1.r2.rps). However, the table note states the figures are not directly comparable because Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline batch size 16. The claim's "tentative evidence ... might possibly achieve higher throughput" overstates comparability; no test was reported (absent:test:exp1/cmp1).
